plan: Root should record source duration, geometry, frame rate, audio stream properties and file size before rendering; retain source narration as the comparison baseline.
Use a deterministic 60fps composition and budget text, character and demo motion so frames do not stall or duplicate merely to inflate output frame rate.
Keep narration timing and pitch intact; apply only justified modest level control and purposeful effects, with no music layer.
Produce a compatible MP4, then validate the actual published player and download against the frozen final file.

acceptance_checks.check: Final MP4 reports 1080x1920, constant 60/1 frame rate, monotonic frame timestamps spaced at 1/60 second within timebase rounding, complete decode with no errors, and synchronized audio duration. Inspect motion-bearing intervals for repeated/stalled frames; metadata alone cannot establish true motion at 60fps. Intentional held cards are exempt.

Compare extracted final narration with the source for retained speech, pace and pitch. Record sample peak, true peak and clipping analysis; require no clipped samples and final true peak at or below -1 dBTP. Confirm the composition/audio asset manifest contains no music. Technical checks cannot certify naturalness.

Review representative frames and all caption/scene boundaries for Arabic shaping, readable contrast, protected placement, no clipping or overlaps, and caption synchronization. Keep the final CTA readable and stationary for a measured hold of at least 2 seconds.

Record render wall time, peak memory if available, codec/profile, pixel format, bitrate and file size. Prefer H.264 with yuv420p, AAC and fast-start metadata for broad player support; disclose any compatibility tradeoff rather than imposing an unsupported file-size limit.

Test the published URL for successful playback and seeking, verify download response and expected file size, and compare the downloaded file hash with the frozen reviewed artifact. A link label alone is insufficient evidence.

limitations: No final video, measurements or publication evidence reviewed in this planning phase.
No human listening capability: waveform measurements and ASR cannot prove that narration sounds natural.
Sales performance, unrelated application infrastructure and store changes are outside this performance review scope.
